mainEntity.name: What is a travel insurance plan for LGBTQ+ travelers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Travel insurance plans for LGBTQ+ travelers are no different than other travel insurance plans that provide coverage for certain events or losses, which may include trip cancellation, lost baggage recovery, medical expense and more. A travel insurance plan can help you enjoy your trip knowing your travel investment is more protected.

mainEntity.name: What does a travel insurance plan cover for LGBTQ+ travelers?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Look for a plan that has the coverage and benefit limits that fit your needs. Popular plan features include: 

- Medical expense coverage 

- NameYour Family® – The ability to choose a person to be included under the definition of family member for purposes of family member-related unforeseen events under your travel insurance plan (optional feature available with certain plans). 

- Trip cancellation/interruption coverage 

- Missed flight connection assistance 

- Baggage coverage 

- Car rental coverage (optional add-on coverage) 

- Cancel For Any Reason (optional add-on coverage available with certain plans)

- Pet bundle – Traveling with your furry family members? Make sure they’re covered too (optional add-on coverage available with certain plans).

- Emergency travel assistance – specialized representatives are available 24/7 to help

mainEntity.name: Do I need a travel insurance plan as an LBGTQ+ traveler?

acceptedAnswer.text: Travel insurance is not typically a requirement when traveling; however, it can be an essential tool when it comes to protecting your travel investment. Travel Guard travel insurance plans come with 24/7 access to our emergency travel services team who can assist with certain travel disruptions you may face. Visit our LGBTQ+ traveler safety page to learn more tips to help ensure your trip is more protected.

mainEntity.name: Which Travel Guard travel insurance plan is best for my LGBTQ+ trip?

acceptedAnswer.text: No matter the type of trip you’re planning, our Preferred Plan is a great place for any traveler to start. It includes popular services and coverages such as medical expense coverage, trip delay and baggage coverage. However, you may want to consider our Deluxe Plan as an option as it has higher coverage limits and additional benefits for your trip which can be tailored to your needs with features such as trip delay, medical expense coverage and travel inconvenience benefits.

mainEntity.name: Can I get a travel insurance plan for less LGBTQ + accepting countries?

acceptedAnswer.text: Travelers are able to get coverage for any destination so long as it’s not listed as an OFAC sanctioned country or region. Visit the official website for the Office of Foreign Assets Control for the most recent updates.

mainEntity.name: Is my partner considered a Family Member under that definition for certain coverages in my travel insurance plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Possibly, in addition to spouses, Travel Guard travel insurance plans include civil union partners and domestic partners under the definition of Family Member. (Note: this can vary by state based on statutory definitions of these terms). Additionally, if there is someone you’d like to include that doesn’t fall under our definition, you can use the Name Your Family® bundle to add an additional person.
